international.title: Middle-aged women in England least likely to successfully quit smoking, study finds
international.summary: Of nearly 8,000 women who tried to stop, only 18% of those aged 45 to 60 managed to give up Middle-aged women in England are the least likely to successfully give up smoking, according to research . Smoking is the leading cause of preventable death and illness in the UK. While overall smoking rates in England have declined in recent decades, rates in some regions have increased. About 6.75 million people smoke in England, of whom around 14% are women aged 45-60. Continue reading...
